pokedexEntries.bk: Blades comprise this Pokémon’s entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.

pokedexEntries.wh: They fight at Bisharp’s command. They cling to their prey and inflict damage by sinking their blades into it.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by sinking the blades that cover their bodies into their prey.

pokedexEntries.as: Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by sinking the blades that cover their bodies into their prey.

pokedexEntries.us: After shredding its prey, it sharpens its blades on a stone by the river. Each Pawniard has its own favorite sharpening stone.

pokedexEntries.um: It follows Bisharp’s orders to a tee when it attacks enemies. After slashing an opponent, Pawniard clangs both of its blades together.

pokedexEntries.sw: It uses river stones to maintain the cutting edges of the blades covering its body. These sharpened blades allow it to bring down opponents.

pokedexEntries.sh: A pack of these Pokémon forms to serve a Bisharp boss. Each Pawniard trains diligently, dreaming of one day taking the lead.

pokedexEntries.sc: Pawniard will fearlessly challenge even powerful foes. In a pinch, it will cling to opponents and pierce them with the blades all over its body.

pokedexEntries.vi: Any chips in its blades would prove fatal for it. After each battle, it diligently maintains its blades using its favorite sharpening stone.
